snippet.title: Lirai: Heir of Darkness - Official Steam Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Lirai: Heir of Darkness is an upcoming third-person action game set in a post-apocalyptic world of zombies and demons, where the obsession to dominate and control the world leads to fear, violence, destruction and, worst of all, extinction. The game has an intense feel, with varied environments and complex character relationships. The storyline reveals dark secrets about what led to the world's collapse. Players will navigate this dangerous world, using their combat skills and clever strategies to survive and uncover the truth in a place where chaos reigns.

Wishlist NOW!🚀 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3251170/Lirai/
